name: Start swarm
description: Transfer this chat turn to Tomo's swarm coordinator after explicit user consent.

function.name: start_swarm
function.description: Start a real session-scoped swarm and transfer this turn to its coordinator. Read the swarm skill. When the user explicitly asks for a swarm/team, call this instead of saying dispatch tools are unavailable. Interpret consent in any language; never infer consent from a mere mention, quotation, or negation. Without explicit consent, propose the split and ask first. Do not call other work tools in the same batch.

request.description: Complete user task, including relevant prior context, boundaries and proposed independent work.

consent_quote.description: Exact substring of the current user message explicitly requesting or approving this swarm.
